We started out counting messages and ended up collecting stories: Tomi's chimichurri in April, the lucky charms of the final, Caro's cake that lasted a week and every door Bruno slammed, always followed by a "did you miss me?".

Some records are a little embarrassing and some words only we understand. Nobody outside knows what a piroola is or why a zorzle is sacred, and that is just fine.

May the next poll go to the barbecue too. See you at the park.

— Ana
